redFirst.basis: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_run_agent_session.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` in a throwaway tree at HEAD: the run timed out: no time was left of the 480-second deadline; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: run-agent-session.py: repeatable --skill NAME (argparse append). find_skills/skill_places resolve each name in order to <tree>/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, then <_claude_home.claude_home()>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, then <PLUGIN_ROOT>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; plugin:skill resolves only from the running plugin (name read from .claude-plugin/plugin.json) with no fallback; names must match SKILL_NAME (no separators). A missing name -> refuse() -> E_USAGE naming the skill and every path looked in; an existing but undecodable/unreadable SKILL.md -> io-error, E_IO. load_skills reads bytes, sha256 of the file bytes; skills_prompt wraps each full SKILL.md as <skill name=...>...</skill>; _prepare writes one <stream>.skills.md under the scratch; session_argv adds --append-system-prompt-file only when skills were named (before --agents, so the resume pair stays last and ras17 still holds). write_record gains a skills list (name, path, sha256) only when skills were named; _run takes an out-dict `ran` so the record carries them whichever outcome follows. The stdin prompt and the reviewer's --agents body are untouched. drive-phase.py: new session_skills(ctx, task) calls the imported _areas.resolve_skills(manifest, phase, task) over load_phase(ctx); writer_argv appends one --skill per name, so the writer, the reviewer, the resume/review-fix dispatches and the validation session all carry it (no resolver copy). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md run-agent-session section describes it. Tests: tests/test_run_agent_session.py stub records the --append-system-prompt-file path and content, HOME/USERPROFILE pinned to the suite scratch with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR empty; new cases ras35-ras46 via _skill_cases; tests/test_drive_phase.py new _session_skill_cases (stage sk-block, STAGES row after rv-block) with sk1-sk3, plus a skills= parameter on _tdd_writer_repo. `claude --help` lists --append-system-prompt[-file] (grep matched 'append-system-prompt' at help lines 26, 56, 240; no paid session launched). Gate: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_run_agent_session.py tests/test_drive_phase.py tests/test__deps.py` run in the task tree with output to a file, exit 0: 3/3 files ok, 869 cases (test__deps 254, test_drive_phase 560, test_run_agent_session 55). ruff check on the four .py files: exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- on run-agent-session.py and its test: exit 0. Dependants: run-agent-session.py's consumers (drive-phase.py write_record is the drive's own stdout writer, unrelated; the drive's reader of the record file takes body.get('line') and ignores the new skills key) still correct; test_run_agent_session/_run and test_drive_phase/_run are their own helpers; exit_for unchanged; _config_rules / _panel_settings / audit-config.schema.json share only the basename text and no new config key was added, so unchanged; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md updated. drive-phase.py: writer_argv signature unchanged, only the argv it returns gains --skill pairs; callers (writer, resume, review-fix, reviewer, validation) all pass through it; tests reading _flag(argv, ...) (ws*, rv*, sr2) still pass in the full run. Not done: the live check that a real claude session sees the appended skills (only the fake claude was used, per the instruction not to launch a paid session). Note: P138.2 touches _areas.py defaults; session_skills reads resolve_skills, so it picks those up without change.
outcome.descriptive: A writer or reviewer session started by the drive now begins with each skill the task resolves to appended to its system prompt, recorded by name, path and digest, and a skill that cannot be found stops the launch by name.

testsAdded: run-agent-session: skills reach the session as one --append-system-prompt-file (each body once, in order, project beats user), wrapped by name, stdin prompt byte-identical
run-agent-session: no --skill means no flag and no file, and no skills key in the record
run-agent-session: a missing skill refuses E_USAGE naming it and all three places looked
run-agent-session: plugin:skill reads only that plugin (a same-named project skill is a decoy), another plugin's name refuses, a path-like name refuses
run-agent-session: the --record line names each skill with path and sha256 (project and user copies of one name differ)
run-agent-session: the reviewer keeps its --agents body and gets the skills beside it
run-agent-session: an undecodable SKILL.md is an io-error, not a missing skill
drive-phase: the writer's and the reviewer's printed commands carry one --skill per resolved skill in order, and none when the task resolves none
